import sqlite3

def insert_employee(name, email, phone):
    conn = sqlite3.connect('employees.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Insert user data into database
    query = f"INSERT INTO users (name, email, phone) VALUES ('{name}', '{email}', '{phone}')"
    cursor.execute(query)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    
    return True

# Example usage
if __name__ == '__main__':
    name = input('Enter name: ')
    email = input('Enter email: ')
    phone = input('Enter phone: ')
    
    insert_employee(name, email, phone)
    print('Employee added successfully')
